formation.title: LLC Formation Wizard
formation.subtitle: We'll guide you through every step.

step1.title: Confirm your residency status
step1.description: Your residency status determines your filing path, EIN eligibility, and compliance obligations.
step1.ssnHolderDescription: You can form an LLC in any state and obtain an EIN online.
step1.itinHolderDescription: You can form an LLC in any state. EIN requires phone or fax submission — MygrationStation handles this for you.
step1.nonResidentDescription: You can form an LLC in any state from abroad. EIN requires fax submission. Additional compliance requirements apply (Form 5472, BOI).
step1.sCorpWarning: Non-resident aliens cannot elect S-Corporation status. Your entity will be taxed as a disregarded entity (single-member) or partnership (multi-member).

step2.title: Choose your state of formation
step2.description: Select the state where you want to form your LLC. Each state has different fees and requirements.
step2.noDirectFiling: This state is not yet supported for direct filing. We will file manually on your behalf.

step3.title: Name your business
step3.description: Choose a name for your LLC. It must be unique in your state of formation.
step3.llcSuffix: LLC suffix will be added automatically
step3.nameAvailable: This name appears to be available. Verify on your state's Secretary of State website before proceeding.
step3.nameWarning: We recommend verifying this name directly with the {state} Secretary of State.
step3.tip1: Must be distinguishable from existing businesses in your state
step3.tip3: Cannot include words implying it is a different entity type (e.g., 'Inc.', 'Corp.')
step3.tip4: Some words may require special licensing (e.g., 'Bank', 'Insurance', 'University')

step4.title: Owner information
step4.description: Provide details about the LLC member(s). This information is used for the Articles of Organization and, if applicable, BOI reporting.
step4.idDocumentDescription: Passport, driver's license, or national ID card
step4.boiRequired: Required for foreign-owned LLCs. Must be filed within 30 days of formation.
step4.boiNotRequired: BOI reporting is not currently required for your entity type.
step4.boiExplanation: The Corporate Transparency Act requires certain companies to report their beneficial owners to FinCEN.

step5.title: Registered agent
step5.description: Every LLC needs a registered agent — a person or company that receives legal documents on behalf of your business.
step5.useMygrationStationDescription: MygrationStation provides a registered agent in your state of formation. Included with your Compliance Annual plan ($199/year) or $149/year standalone.
step5.useOwnDescription: Provide the name and address of your registered agent. This person must have a physical address in your state of formation.

step6.title: Review and sign
step6.description: Review your information carefully. After signing, we'll prepare your Articles of Organization for filing.
step6.signDescription: You'll be redirected to sign your Articles of Organization electronically.

step7.title: الدفع
step7.description: اختر خطتك وأكمل الدفع لبدء عملية التقديم.
step7.standardDescription: تقديم طلب تأسيس LLC في الولاية التي اخترتها
standardIncludes: اتفاقية التشغيل (عضو واحد أو متعدد الأعضاء)
المستندات المقدمة مخزنة في خزنتك الآمنة
step7.proDescription: تأسيس LLC + نحصل على EIN الخاص بك نيابة عنك
premiumIncludes: المساعدة في تقديم التقرير السنوي للولاية
المساعدة في فتح وإعداد الحساب البنكي

step8.title: You're all set!
step8.description: Your LLC formation application has been submitted. Here's what happens next.
step8.step1Text: Our team reviews your application (1-2 business days)
step8.step2Text: We file your Articles of Organization with the {state} Secretary of State
step8.step3Text: You'll receive your filed documents via email and in your document vault
step8.einNext: Once your LLC is formed, we'll begin the EIN application process automatically.
